name: ticket-planner
description: 11-phase autonomous planner — turns business ideas into dependency-ordered planned tickets. Appraisal → Discovery → Architecture → Specify → Review → Consensus → Crosscheck → Epic Gen → Ticket Gen → Refinement → Completed. Produces Planner Context blocks, Branch Directives for shared epic branches, and initiative epics with tickets that pass a deterministic + semantic readiness check before fleet-controller dispatch.
